teaser.en: The 'forest lime' that bleeds milk: a glossy-leaved forest tree with two names, one for its look and one for its latex.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' unaotoa maziwa: mti wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa na majina mawili, moja kwa sura yake na jingine kwa utomvu wake.
teaser.dg: 'Mdimu wa tsakani' unaolavya maziya: muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala, na madzina mairi, rimwenga kpwa vira unavyoonekana na ranjina kpwa maziyage.

summary.en: Mdimu tsaka is a forest tree with glossy leaves and white latex. Digo people see it as a wild, forest form of the lime tree, and also call it mziyaziya, 'milk'.
summary.sw: Mdimu tsaka ni mti wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa na utomvu mweupe. Wadigo huuona kuwa aina ya mwituni, ya msituni, ya mdimu, na pia huuita *mziyaziya*, 'maziwa'.
summary.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* ni muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza ganayong'ala na maziya mereru. Adigo anauona dza aina ya weruni, ya tsakani, ya *mdimu*, na piya anauiha *mziyaziya*, 'maziya'.

about.en: Mdimu tsaka is an evergreen shrub or tree with smooth bark and copious white latex. Its leaves are opposite, glossy and leathery, rather like those of a citrus tree. Small, fragrant white flowers grow in clusters, followed by smooth, rounded fruits that ripen yellow to orange, often in pairs. Digo people identify it by the look and smell of its leaves.
about.sw: Mdimu tsaka ni kichaka au mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye gome laini na utomvu mweupe mwingi. Majani yake hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanang'aa na ni magumu kama ngozi, yanafanana kiasi na yale ya mti wa jamii ya michungwa. Maua madogo meupe yenye harufu nzuri huota katika vishada, yakifuatwa na matunda laini ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya manjano hadi machungwa, mara nyingi mawili mawili. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Mdimu tsaka* ni chitsaka au muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye gopha laini na maziya mereru manji sana. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalolana, ganang'ala na ni magumu dza chingo, chidide dza ga muhi wa jamii ya mdimu. Maruwa madide mereru ga arufu nono ganamera kpwa mabunda, na badaye ganalavya matunda laini ga duara, ganayoiva na kukala rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa, mara nyinji mairi-mairi. Adigo anaumanya kpwa vira makodzage ganavyoonekana na arufu yago.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket, including kaya forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka, zikiwemo misitu ya kaya.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani na vitsakani, phamwenga na matsaka ga kaya.

uses.en: Pakia records that its latex has no known use.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba utomvu wake hauna matumizi yanayojulikana.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala maziyage tagana kazi inayomanyikana.

culture.en: Pakia discusses the word *maziya*, 'milk', which goes back to an old Bantu root. Today it also covers plant latex. He gives this tree and *Suregada zanzibariensis* as examples of plants with *maziya* that 'has no known use', unlike the medicinal latex of *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* is a milk-like exudate that may or may not be useful, but is generally not harmful.
culture.sw: Pakia anajadili neno *maziya*, 'maziwa', ambalo asili yake ni mzizi wa zamani wa Kibantu. Siku hizi linajumuisha pia utomvu wa mimea. Anatoa mti huu na *Suregada zanzibariensis* kama mifano ya mimea yenye *maziya* 'yasiyo na matumizi yanayojulikana', tofauti na utomvu wa kitiba wa *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* ni majimaji kama maziwa yanayotoka kwenye mmea, ambayo yanaweza kuwa na manufaa au yasiwe nayo, lakini kwa kawaida hayana madhara.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza neno *maziya*, 'maziya', ririrolavywa kula muzi wa kare sana wa luga za Chibantu. Rero piya rinahusu maziya ga mimea. Anapha muhi hinyu na *Suregada zanzibariensis* dza mifwano ya mimea yenye *maziya* 'gasigo na kazi inayomanyikana', tafwauti na maziya ga dawa ga *Euphorbia hirta*. *Maziya* ni madzi dza maziya ganayotuluka kpwa mmea, ambago ganaweza kukala na fwaida au gasikale nayo, ela kpwa kawaida tagalumiza mutu.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'lime plant in the forest', because it is considered the forest form of *mdimu*, the lime. Also *mziyaziya*, 'milk', which Pakia calls the basic name for latex-producing plants, shared with Duruma. Both names are shared with other plants. *Mdimu tsaka* is also *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* is also the white milkwood, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato gives *tsaka* as 'forest; wild', *maziya* as milk and *ndimu* as lime.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni', kwa sababu unachukuliwa kuwa aina ya msituni ya *mdimu*. Pia *mziyaziya*, 'maziwa', ambalo Pakia analiita jina la msingi la mimea inayotoa utomvu, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na mimea mingine. *Mdimu tsaka* pia ni *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* pia ni *white milkwood*, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato anatoa *tsaka* kwa maana ya 'msitu; -a porini', *maziya* kwa maana ya maziwa na *ndimu* kwa maana ya ndimu.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa tsakani', kpwa sababu unaonwa kukala ni aina ya tsakani ya *mdimu*, muhi wa ndimu. Piya ni *mziyaziya*, 'maziya', dzina ambaro Pakia anagomba ni dzina ra msingi ra mimea inayolavya maziya, na ni ra Chiduruma piya. Madzina gosi mairi ganahumirwa piya kpwa mimea yanjina. *Mdimu tsaka* piya ni *Suregada zanzibariensis*. *Mziyaziya* piya ni *white milkwood*, *Sideroxylon inerme* (*mkoko bara*). Mgombato unapha *tsaka* mana ya 'msitu; -a mwitu', *maziya* mana ya 'maziwa', na *ndimu* mana ya 'ndimu'.

reason.sw: Mdimu, ambao jina lake limetokana nao
reason.dg: *Mdimu*, muhi wa ndimu ambao dzina hiri rikalavywa kpwakpwe

definition.en: The harmless milky latex of this plant.
definition.sw: Utomvu wa mmea huu, kama maziwa na usio na madhara.
definition.dg: Maziya ga mmea hinyu, ambago tagalumiza mutu.
